snippet.title: Boom Ascent Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Official Trailer of my upcoming game Boom Ascent. Available on PC.
You can play the demo now on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642650/Boom_Ascent/

Boom Ascent is a "Foddian" game where you control a skeleton in a a flower pot by using bombs to move. Your goal is to reach the very top of the world without falling. You use your mouse buttons to aim and to control the explosion power.

The game is inspired by Jump King by Nexile.
